snippet.description:
🍗🚀 CHICKENAUTS EARLY ACCESS OUT NOW 🚀🍗

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350460/Chickenauts/

Them no-good UFO mutant chickens got your sweet flock. Load your guns. Some say that the revenge is best served cold. This one’s gonna be deep-fried, with a rancher sauce on the side.
